text: So here we are again once more
我们再次立于起点
Your gaze once bright - now blunt and soulless
你曾经明亮的目光，已然混沌而无情
Your pain is aching for revenge
痛苦不堪的灵魂，叫嚣着复仇的渴望
It's burning every bridge between us
我们之间的连结，正逐渐支离破碎
Yet his bleeding soul yearns for your fate
他的灵魂，吞噬你的命运
Through his rage you've sunk into the abyss
他的愤怒，引你踏入深渊
Can you hear the voice of our youth calling?
你可曾听见，属于年轻战士的呐喊
It's time to face the truth
你可有勇气，直视眼前的真相
